series.zh: Google Cloud 演讲：智能体系统

title.en: Design agent teams, not one super-agent.
title.zh: 设计智能体团队，而不是一个超级智能体。

subtitle.en: A technical-talk lesson on explaining multi-agent architecture through roles, handoffs, protocols, and responsibility boundaries.
subtitle.zh: 一节技术演讲表达课：用角色、交接、协议和责任边界解释 multi-agent 架构。

audience: AI engineer · Solution architect · Product-facing engineer

source.title: Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform: Adding memory to AI agents
source.speaker: Google Cloud Tech

note.en: Selected as a recent Google Cloud agentic AI talk/blog topic. The lesson turns the public architecture framing into customer-facing explanation drills.
note.zh: 选自最近 Google Cloud agentic AI 公开技术主题。本课把公开架构 framing 转成面向客户的解释训练。

scenario.customer: The customer wants one autonomous agent to research, plan, execute, approve, and update systems across several departments.
scenario.weakResponse: We can build a very powerful agent with tools, memory, planning, and access to your systems.
scenario.reliableResponse: I would separate that into an agent team. Each agent should have a clear role, a bounded toolset, an escalation path, and a protocol for handing work to the next agent or a human reviewer.

principle.zh: Multi-agent 设计，本质上是责任设计。

flow.en: Start with why one large agent becomes hard to evaluate, govern, and debug.
flow.zh: 先解释为什么一个大 agent 很难评估、治理和调试。

flow.en: Introduce agent roles as professional responsibilities, not personalities.
flow.zh: 把 agent role 讲成专业职责，而不是人格设定。

flow.en: Explain handoffs as the architecture of collaboration.
flow.zh: 把 handoff 讲成协作架构。

flow.en: Use protocol language to make cross-agent communication sound controlled.
flow.zh: 用 protocol 语言让跨 agent 沟通听起来可控。

flow.en: Close with production controls: observability, permissions, evaluation, and human escalation.
flow.zh: 用生产控制收尾：可观测性、权限、评估和人工升级。

intent.en: Slow down a broad agent request.
intent.zh: 专业放慢过宽的 agent 需求。

phraseBank.line: Before we make one agent more autonomous, I would split the work into accountable roles.

why.en: It accepts the ambition while changing the design lens.
why.zh: 它接住野心，同时改变设计视角。

phraseBank.line: The handoff is where we preserve context, transfer responsibility, and decide whether a human needs to step in.

why.en: This makes handoff sound like a serious system boundary.
why.zh: 这让 handoff 听起来像严肃的系统边界。

phraseBank.line: A shared protocol prevents every agent from inventing its own way to ask for help.

why.en: It explains a technical standard through a human collaboration analogy.
why.zh: 它用人类协作类比解释技术标准。

meaning.en: The transfer of work, context, and responsibility from one actor to another.
meaning.zh: 把工作、上下文和责任从一个执行者转给另一个。

use.en: A weak handoff causes context loss; a strong handoff preserves accountability.
use.zh: 弱 handoff 会丢上下文；强 handoff 会保留责任。

meaning.en: A limited set of tools an agent is allowed to use.
meaning.zh: agent 被允许使用的一组有限工具。

use.en: A bounded toolset makes the agent easier to reason about.
use.zh: Bounded toolset 让 agent 更容易被理解和治理。

meaning.en: A shared rule or format for communication between systems.
meaning.zh: 系统之间沟通的一套共享规则或格式。

use.en: Protocols matter when different agents need to collaborate reliably.
use.zh: 当不同 agent 需要可靠协作时，protocol 很重要。

meaning.en: The ability to inspect what happened inside a system and why.
meaning.zh: 查看系统内部发生了什么以及为什么发生的能力。

use.en: Without observability, multi-agent behavior becomes hard to trust.
use.zh: 没有 observability，multi-agent 行为就难以被信任。

intent.zh: 把自主性转成范围问题。

logicMoves.line: The question is not how autonomous the agent can be, but where autonomy is bounded enough to be trusted.

why.en: It reframes autonomy as a controlled design decision.
why.zh: 把自主性重构成受控设计决策。

intent.zh: 解释为什么团队胜过超级 agent。

logicMoves.line: A team of agents lets us separate expertise, permissions, and failure modes.

why.en: It gives a practical reason for architectural decomposition.
why.zh: 给架构拆分一个实际理由。

logicMoves.line: If we cannot tell which agent made which decision, the system is already too opaque.

why.en: It makes traceability a design requirement.
why.zh: 它把可追踪性变成设计要求。

conversationLessons.en: A good technical talk makes architecture sound like disciplined collaboration.
conversationLessons.zh: 好的技术演讲会把架构讲成有纪律的协作。

conversationLessons.en: Agent roles should reduce ambiguity, not decorate a demo.
conversationLessons.zh: Agent role 应该减少模糊性，而不是装饰 demo。

conversationLessons.en: When explaining multi-agent systems, always connect capability to evaluation and ownership.
conversationLessons.zh: 解释 multi-agent 时，一定要把能力连接到评估和责任归属。

anchor.quote: Autonomy should be bounded enough to be trusted.

concept.en: The word bounded is powerful in AI conversations because it says you understand ambition and risk at the same time.
concept.zh: Bounded 在 AI 对话里很有力量，因为它同时表达野心和风险意识。

examples.line: This agent should own recommendation, not approval.

why.en: It draws a crisp responsibility boundary.

examples.line: We can give the agent read access first, then expand write access only after the evals are stable.

why.en: It turns risk into a staged rollout plan.
why.zh: 它把风险转成分阶段上线计划。

examples.line: When confidence drops or policy risk rises, the system should escalate rather than improvise.

why.en: It gives the system a mature failure behavior.
why.zh: 它给系统一个成熟的失败行为。

intent.en: Push back on a super-agent design.
intent.zh: 反对超级 agent 设计。

lines.line: A super-agent may look simpler in a diagram, but it is harder to evaluate, govern, and debug in production.

why.en: It compares demo simplicity with production complexity.
why.zh: 它对比了 demo 简洁和生产复杂度。

lines.line: I would design the agents around roles, handoffs, and permissions, not around how impressive the demo feels.

why.en: It pulls the design back to responsible architecture.
why.zh: 它把设计拉回负责任的架构。

lines.line: The protocol gives agents a shared language for requesting help, passing context, and reporting outcomes.

why.en: It makes an abstract protocol feel concrete.
why.zh: 它让抽象协议变得具体。

lines.line: Human review should sit at the points where judgment, policy, or irreversible action enters the workflow.

why.en: It defines human-in-the-loop by decision type.
why.zh: 它按决策类型定义 human-in-the-loop。

lines.line: The goal is not just agent collaboration; it is collaboration we can observe, evaluate, and improve.

why.en: It turns collaboration into a managed production loop.
why.zh: 它把协作变成可管理的生产循环。

prompt.en: Practice explaining a multi-agent architecture to a customer.
prompt.zh: 练习向客户解释 multi-agent 架构。

steps.en: The customer asks for one agent to do everything.
steps.zh: 客户要求一个 agent 做所有事。

focus.en: Use evaluate, govern, and debug to explain the risk.

steps.en: The team wants agents to call sensitive tools.
steps.zh: 团队希望 agents 调用敏感工具。

focus.en: Explain tool access as a bounded permission decision.
focus.zh: 把工具访问解释成有边界的权限决策。

steps.en: A stakeholder asks why protocols matter.
steps.zh: 利益相关方问为什么 protocol 重要。
